dog.description_text:
Merlin: the wizard of Brooklyn (with the beard to prove it!) 🧙‍♂️✨

Merlin is a 6-year-old, 15-pound small mixed breed (terrier) from New York City! He’s a loving, enthusiastic, sweet pup with a magic all his own. We nicknamed him Merlin because that beard looks like it belongs to a wizard.

Melin's story:
Merlin came to us from Queens ACC, where he had a very hard time with fear and illness. Since entering his foster home in Brooklyn, he’s adjusted beautifully, and his true self has come out.

His spells and charms, Melin's idea of a perfect day includes:

🐾 Walks, which he’s thrilled about every time
😴 Snoozing on his back with his feet in the air like a dead bug
🌪️ Rolling and tumbling around the floor like the Tasmanian Devil, entertaining himself in the most bizarre and wonderful way
🗣️ Chatting with his humans, mumbling and making tiny whistle sounds when he’s happy or excited
🤗 Giving hugs: he’ll wrap his little paws around your leg and rest his head against you

The practical magic

- Housebroken: A wee-pad is kept out in foster just in case, and he has never had an accident in the home. He's fully house-trained.

- Dog-friendly: He’s great with other dogs and very well behaved on walks.

- City-ready: He’s the perfect city apartment dog! He gets chilly easily, so he wears a coat on walks.

His ideal home
Merlin's forever family will be patient and consistent, willing to keep building on the progress he’s made, and comfortable respecting his boundaries while gently working on his manners. While he's not been fostered with tiny humans, because he appreciates his space, we'd recommend Merlin go to a home with older children (12+) only.

Are you ready to meet this little wizard?🪄

Vaccinated for rabies, DHPP, and bordetella, heartworm negative, neutered and microchipped. Current on flea, tick, and heartworm prevention.

To apply for Merlin, visit our website (www.waggytailrescue.org) for an adoption application. It is important to fill out an application as soon as possible for consideration, and we require a complete application for you to meet an animal. We are currently unable to respond to general email inquiries as an all-volunteer run rescue. If the dog is on our website, they are still available.

Waggytail Rescue CANNOT guarantee the exact age of any adoptable dog, or final size of any of our adoptable puppies. We rely on the information provided to us by veterinarians, shelters, owner surrenders and other circumstances bringing the dog into our rescue.

Adoptions: adopt@waggytailrescue.org
